requirement: Keep a ring of ES256 signing keys identified by kid, sign with the newest key, verify each token with the key its kid names, and let old keys be retired.
skeleton: UnknownKeyError, and a KeyRing class with rotate generating P-256 keys, retire guarding the active key, sign encoding with a kid header, and verify reading the unverified header then decoding with the named public key.
caption: Signing-key rotation for JWTs with PyJWT and cryptography. UnknownKeyError subclasses jwt.InvalidTokenError. KeyRing keeps P-256 private keys by kid in an instance dict plus the active kid. rotate(kid) raises ValueError saying the kid must be new and non-empty when it is blank or already present, otherwise generates ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1()) and makes it active. retire(kid) raises ValueError when asked to drop the active signing key and otherwise removes the key. sign(claims) raises LookupError saying there is no active signing key before the first rotation, and otherwise encodes the claims with ES256 and the active private key, putting the kid in the JWT header. verify(token) reads the kid with jwt.get_unverified_header; a missing, non-string or unknown kid raises UnknownKeyError naming its repr. It then decodes with the public half of that kid's key and algorithms pinned to ES256, so a token from another ring reusing the same kid raises jwt.InvalidSignatureError. The fixture asserts that the header is alg ES256, kid k1 and typ JWT and the claims round-trip, that a k1 token still verifies after rotating to k2, that retiring k1 makes it raise UnknownKeyError, that retiring the active key raises ValueError, that the other ring's k1 token raises jwt.InvalidSignatureError, that an HS256 token without kid raises UnknownKeyError, and that signing with no key raises LookupError while duplicate or empty kids raise ValueError.

plan.intent: Rotate JWT signing keys without breaking live tokens
constraints: New tokens carry the active kid in their header
Tokens signed with older kept keys still verify
Retired or unknown kids raise UnknownKeyError
The active key cannot be retired (ValueError)
kids must be new and non-empty (ValueError)
Signing before any rotation raises LookupError
Signatures are verified with the named key, so reused kids raise jwt.InvalidSignatureError

rationale.teaches: Put the kid in the JWT header at signing time and use jwt.get_unverified_header only to pick which public key jwt.decode verifies with.
rationale.why: Verifying everything with the current key breaks every live session at rotation, and trusting the header without verifying lets any key holder forge tokens.

ops.docstring: Rotate ES256 signing keys by kid while tokens signed earlier keep verifying.

ops.source:
class UnknownKeyError(jwt.InvalidTokenError):
    """The token's kid header names no key in the ring."""

candidates.why_wrong: Every token is verified with the active key, so older tokens fail after rotation.
The active signing key can be retired, leaving the ring unable to verify its own tokens.
Tokens are signed without a kid header, so verify cannot find their key.
Rotating to an existing kid silently replaces its key and orphans tokens.
Signature verification is disabled, so tokens from any key are accepted.
